files.search.css: .token-search{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;border:1px solid #929fb3;border-radius:8px;padding:6px}.token-search:focus-within{outline:2px solid #4169bd}.token-search ol{display:contents;list-style:none}.token-search li{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid #b1bfd8;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden;background:#eaf0fc}.token-search button{font:inherit;padding:6px;background:transparent;border:0;cursor:pointer}.token-search input{font:inherit;flex:1 1 160px;min-width:80px;border:0;padding:8px;background:transparent}.token-search button:focus-visible,.token-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #315cba;outline-offset:-2px}.search-help{font:12px system-ui;color:#4b5567}[role=listbox]{list-style:none;padding:4px;margin:4px 0;border:1px solid #bdc5d3;border-radius:6px;max-height:220px;overflow:auto}[role=option]{padding:8px;cursor:pointer}[role=option][aria-selected=true]{background:#dbe7ff;text-decoration:underline}.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)}
